Reheat Instructions: Microwave for 45-60 seconds until heated through. Or reheat in the oven at 350 degrees F for 8-10 minutes. Best enjoyed within 4-5 days.

Item: Black Bean & Chipotle Hummus
Reheat Instructions: Serve cold or at room temperature. Remove from fridge 10-15 minutes before serving for best texture. Stir well before serving. Best enjoyed within 5-7 days.

Reheat Instructions: Serve cold or at room temperature. Remove from fridge 10-15 minutes before serving for best texture. Drizzle with olive oil before serving. Best enjoyed within 5-7 days.

Item: Asian Wild Rice & Collard Greens Beef Soup with carrots, celery, onion, garlic, ginger, tomato, soy sauce, fish sauce, scallions & coconut milk
Reheat Instructions: Pour into a saucepan over medium heat. Stir occasionally and heat for 8-10 minutes until warmed through. Or microwave in a microwave-safe bowl for 2-3 minutes, stirring halfway through. Add a splash of broth if needed.

Item: Nourishing White Bean & Lemon Soup with onion, carrots, celery, garlic, chickpeas, kale, lemon, parmesan & cannellini beans
Reheat Instructions: Pour into a saucepan over medium heat. Stir occasionally and heat for 8-10 minutes until warmed through. Or microwave in a microwave-safe bowl for 2-3 minutes, stirring halfway through. Add a splash of broth if needed.

Category: Kids/Comfort Foods (Served with steamed green beans)
Item: Baked Sage Chicken Meatballs over shallot mashed sweet potatoes
Reheat Instructions: Reheat meatballs in a saucepan over medium-low heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally. Or microwave covered for 2-3 minutes. Reheat mashed sweet potatoes in the microwave in 60-second intervals, stirring between each, adding a splash of milk or pat of butter to restore creaminess. Serve with steamed green beans.

Category: Kids/Comfort Foods (Served with steamed green beans)
Item: Instant Pot Korean Beef over jasmine rice with soy sauce, ginger, sesame oil, garlic, miso, onion, shredded red cabbage & scallions
Reheat Instructions: Reheat beef in a skillet over medium heat for 3-5 minutes, stirring occasionally, or microwave covered for 60-90 seconds. Reheat jasmine rice in the microwave with a damp paper towel on top for 60-90 seconds. Serve beef over rice topped with shredded red cabbage and scallions. Serve with steamed green beans.

Category: Kids/Comfort Foods (Served with steamed green beans)
Item: Ground Chicken & Cheese Quesadillas
Reheat Instructions: Reheat in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side until crispy and cheese is melted. Or reheat in the oven at 375 degrees F on a baking sheet for 8-10 minutes. Avoid the microwave to keep them crispy. Serve with steamed green beans.

Category: Kids/Comfort Foods (Served with steamed green beans)
Item: Chimichurri Flank Steak & Roasted Baby Potatoes
Reheat Instructions: Reheat flank steak in the oven at 325 degrees F covered with foil for 10-12 minutes until warmed through - avoid overcooking to preserve tenderness. Reheat roasted baby potatoes in the oven at 400 degrees F for 8-10 minutes to restore crispiness. Serve with steamed green beans.

Item: Chipotle Street Corn Chicken Salad with charred corn, red onion, jalapeno, cilantro, chipotle pepper, mayo, lime & shredded chicken
Reheat Instructions: Serve cold directly from the refrigerator. Stir well before serving. Best enjoyed within 3-4 days.

Item: Lentil Salad with cucumber, dates, mint, parsley, red onion, feta, pistachios & lemon dijon dressing
Reheat Instructions: Serve at room temperature. Dress and toss just before serving. Best enjoyed within 3-4 days.

Item: Seasoned Shrimp Sweet Potato Bowl with avocado, roasted sweet potatoes, pico de gallo & hot honey sauce
Reheat Instructions: Reheat shrimp and sweet potatoes in the oven at 325 degrees F for 8-10 minutes - be careful not to overcook the shrimp. Slice avocado fresh just before serving and drizzle with hot honey sauce. Best enjoyed within 2-3 days.

Item: Chicken & Quinoa Burrito Bowl with grilled corn, cherry tomatoes, avocado, black beans & tangy spicy green sauce
Reheat Instructions: Reheat chicken and quinoa together in the microwave for 60-90 seconds. Assemble bowl with corn, tomatoes, and black beans. Slice avocado fresh just before serving and drizzle with the spicy green sauce. Best enjoyed within 3-4 days.

Item: Creamy Lemon Chicken & Orzo with chickpeas, baby spinach, parmesan & a touch of heavy cream
Reheat Instructions: Reheat in a saucepan over medium-low heat with a splash of broth or cream for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until heated through. Or microwave covered for 2-3 minutes, stirring halfway through.

Item: Pan Seared Salmon with thai sweet chili glaze over cilantro lime rice & garlicky broccolini
Reheat Instructions: Reheat salmon in the oven at 275 degrees F on a foil-covered baking sheet for 10-12 minutes until just warmed through - low and slow preserves the glaze and prevents drying out. Reheat rice and broccolini separately in the microwave for 60-90 seconds. Serve salmon over rice.

Item: Mongolian Beef with soy sauce, ginger, garlic, scallions, honey over rice with green beans
Reheat Instructions: Reheat beef in a skillet or wok over medium-high heat with a light drizzle of oil for 3-5 minutes, tossing frequently. Reheat rice in the microwave with a damp paper towel on top for 60-90 seconds. Serve beef over rice.

Item: Eggplant Lasagna Boats filled with mushrooms, spinach, marinara, cottage cheese & mozzarella cheese over wilted kale
Reheat Instructions: Reheat in an oven-safe dish covered with foil at 350 degrees F for 20-25 minutes until heated through and cheese is bubbly. Remove foil for the last 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. Reheat kale separately in a skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes.
